summary: Apps are written in an imperative Rust App trait with retained views, not a declarative View/Scene/App protocol tree. Most App-structure and Data-and-storage topics have a feature-level counterpart (documents, sheets, toolbars, search field, observable values, defaults, state restoration); SwiftData-style model persistence, the Environment, preferences keys and app extensions in the SwiftUI sense have none.
